name: Ezra Song

bullets: Shipped responsive production features with Next.js, React, TypeScript, NestJS, and PostgreSQL, reducing UI duplication across frontend and backend systems.
Worked on project orchestration layers; evaluated AI tools, frameworks, and competing workflows.
Tested and deployed releases with Supabase, Docker, GitHub Actions, Vitest, and Playwright to catch regressions.
Built iOS/macOS features with Swift and SwiftUI, integrating backend services for reliable workflows.
Built reusable React/JavaScript components and responsive HTML/CSS layouts from design feedback.
Tested navigation, forms, error states, and breakpoints with browser tools; documented defect steps, environments, and severity for clearer handoffs.
Built reusable screens, navigation, and responsive states in React Native/Expo for faster mobile prototyping.
Modularized REST API calls and centralized state with React Context; tested user flows and device sizes to resolve edge cases and keep screen data consistent.
Built reusable React/JavaScript and responsive HTML/CSS components for accessibility and consistent layouts.
Fixed layout regressions with browser developer tools, cross-browser QA, and targeted CSS changes before release.

projects.title: Sonolyth
bullets: Maintained an Android Spotube/Flutter fork: native playback, music plugins, synced lyrics, and Spotify metadata fixes.
Versioned the app and HetuScript plugin in a monorepo; added nested playlist/album/artist folders, HTTP 429 retries, and preserved upstream sync.

projects.title: Discord Automation Bot
bullets: Built slash commands for moderation, reaction roles, internship alerts, and AMP server monitoring/control with instance autocomplete and permission checks.
Added queued Lavalink music over WebSockets; deployed with Docker Compose/Unraid and bounded caches/V8 heap to keep idle memory near 30–40 MB.
